tests.name: TestSBOMContextVMGenerateReturnsAcceptedAckAndEnqueues
tests.notes: Verifies sbom/generate returns service.SBOMAcceptedAck, not SBOMRunResult, and forwards subjectLocator into the enqueue request.

tests.name: TestSBOMContextVMImportReturnsAcceptedAckAndEnqueues
tests.notes: Verifies sbom/import returns the accepted coordinate, decodes inline payload deterministically, and forwards package subjectLocator into the enqueue request.

tests.name: TestSBOMAsyncRunnerAcceptedAckThenWorkerPublishesAfterAUTHAndOK
tests.notes: Starts the managed channel runner, enqueues generation, injects AUTH then EOSE and OK accepted relay outcomes, and waits on the runner result channel without sleeps.

tests.name: TestSBOMAsyncRunnerImportAckThenWorkerPublishesAfterOK
tests.notes: Exercises the real EnqueueImport worker branch with deterministic OK/EOSE outcomes and verifies 30078/30004 publication and imported projection source kind.

tests.name: TestSBOMAsyncRunnerSurfacesClosedBeforeEOSEWithoutAvailabilityPublication
tests.notes: Injects CLOSED before EOSE and verifies the worker returns a deterministic error without publishing 30004 or projecting a manifest.

tests.name: TestSBOMAsyncRunnerSurfacesOKRejectionWithoutProjection
tests.notes: Injects OK accepted=false auth-required and verifies worker error propagation without projection.

tests.name: TestSBOMAsyncRunnerRejectsFullQueueWithoutPolling
tests.notes: Verifies immediate queue-backpressure failure rather than sleeping, polling, or blocking on completion.
